verdict.rationale: Dynadot's first-party API page says domains can be registered through API commands and that the API manages DNS, orders and account settings across more than 120 actions. That covers the purchase step of a scripted registration. The pack does not document contact handling or nameserver setting as specific API calls, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API calls for setting registrant contacts, documented API calls for setting nameservers at registration, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation of an end-to-end scripted registration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register a domain end to end via the API — purchase, contacts, and nameservers in documented calls, so registration can be part of a deploy script

citations.quote: Build your account by registering, transferring, and renewing domains through commands.
The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities. Our API supports more than 120 actions
